characters.name: Nora
characters.look: a woman in her thirties in a grey wool sweater and jeans, long brown braid

locations.name: Farmhouse Kitchen
locations.look: a farmhouse kitchen at night, one hanging bulb, a wooden table and a window to the dark yard

locations.name: Gravel Yard
locations.look: a gravel farmyard at night under a single porch light, an old barn in the background

locations.name: Barn Interior
locations.look: the inside of an old wooden barn, hay, a lantern, tall double doors

scenes.narration: At eleven fifty, Nora's phone lit up on the kitchen table: “Don't open the barn.”
scenes.image_prompt: a phone glowing face down on a wooden kitchen table at night, Nora's hand reaching for it, rule of thirds
scenes.image_prompt_2: Nora reading her phone by a dark window, worried, medium shot

scenes.narration: The message came from her brother's number. Her brother had been missing for three years.
scenes.image_prompt: an old framed photograph of a young man on a kitchen shelf, close-up, warm lamp light
scenes.image_prompt_2: Nora staring at the phone, the screen light on her face, close-up

scenes.narration: She grabbed a flashlight and ran across the gravel yard toward the barn.
scenes.image_prompt: Nora running across a gravel farmyard at night with a flashlight beam, diagonal composition
scenes.image_prompt_2: the barn's tall double doors at the end of the yard, flashlight beam leading toward them

scenes.narration: The barn door was already open. Inside, the hay was pressed flat, as if someone had slept there for years.
scenes.image_prompt: the barn's tall doors standing open into darkness, frame within a frame
scenes.image_prompt_2: a patch of flattened hay in the lantern light, close-up

scenes.narration: Then the door slammed shut behind her, and the lantern on the post went out.
scenes.image_prompt: Nora spinning toward the barn doors as they close, flashlight beam cutting diagonally
scenes.image_prompt_2: a lantern on a wooden post going dark, wisp of smoke, close-up

scenes.narration: Hours later, the sheriff found Nora's phone in the yard. The last text on it was one she had sent herself.
scenes.image_prompt: a phone lying face up on gravel at dawn, cold blue light, high angle
scenes.image_prompt_2: a sheriff's patrol car at the edge of a farmyard at dawn, wide shot

scenes.narration: So who warned her? And who was waiting in the barn?
scenes.image_prompt: the old barn at dawn, doors closed, mist across the yard, wide shot, centered
scenes.image_prompt_2: the kitchen table at dawn with an empty chair, the hanging bulb still on
